meta.title: Arvys
home.scaffold: Scaffold from step 5 of the genesis. Screens and routes are step 6.
escritorio.vazio.titulo: Nothing here yet — and that is expected.
escritorio.vazio.explicacao: Arvys shows the work that lives on your computer. Until you push something, this screen stays empty.
escritorio.chegou.guardado: It is all stored in this office.
escritorio.passo1.titulo: 1. Install the plugin in your Claude Code
escritorio.passo1.detalhe: It is what makes Arvys work alongside you on your machine.
escritorio.passo2.detalhe: It asks for the token on this page and links your computer to this office.
escritorio.token.aviso: Copy it now: for security, this value is not shown again.
escritorio.carregando.detalhe: This can take a few seconds the first time.
escritorio.token.nenhum: No machine is linked to this office yet.

cli.ajuda.titulo: arvys — your office in the cloud
cli.ajuda.login: paste the token the /escritorio page showed you once
cli.ajuda.whoami: says who is logged in on this machine
cli.ajuda.syncEnable: turns push on for THIS repo (shows the list and asks for confirmation)
cli.ajuda.syncStatus: says whether this repo pushes, and how many are pending
cli.ajuda.sync: drains the changes the screen requested and pushes what changed
cli.ajuda.tasksMigrate: gives a metadata block to every story in tasks.md that doesn't have one yet
cli.ajuda.restore: rebuilds the file tree from the last push, into an empty directory
cli.restore.diretorioNaoVazio: the current directory is not empty — run `arvys restore` in an empty folder, so nothing gets overwritten.
cli.restore.semPush: this office has not received any push yet — there is nothing to restore.
cli.ajuda.credencial: The credential lives in ~/.arvys/credentials, OUTSIDE the repo.
cli.ajuda.listaBranca: Only the allow-list goes up (company/, agents/, specs/, incidents/) — never .env, never .jsonl, never source code.
cli.login.tokenInvalido: invalid token — it starts with arv_live_ and comes from the /escritorio page.
cli.login.permissaoAtencao: WARNING: could not restrict the permission ({como}).
cli.login.permissaoConfira: Check who else can read that file before going on.
cli.whoami.recusado: token refused by the server (401) — run `arvys login` again.
cli.whoami.cache: WARNING: this is CACHE, confirmed at {quando} — I could not reach the server just now.
cli.whoami.naoConfirmada: account not confirmed by the server yet, and I could not reach it just now.
cli.logout.naoHavia: there was no credential on this machine.
cli.sync.empurraDesde: this repo has been pushing since {quando}.
cli.sync.naoEmpurra: this repo does NOT push (`arvys sync enable`).
cli.sync.usoInvalido: use `arvys sync`, `arvys sync enable` or `arvys sync status`.
cli.sync.resumo.cabecalho: These {total} files ({tamanho}) would go up from this repo:
cli.sync.resumo.nadaMais: Nothing else goes up: no .env, no .jsonl, no source code.
cli.sync.pergunta: Type "{palavra}" to turn push on for this repo:
cli.sync.jaHabilitado: this repo has already been pushing since {quando}.
cli.sync.recusado: nothing was written — the repo is exactly as it was.
cli.sync.habilitado: push turned on for this repo ({arquivos} files in the opt-in).
cli.sync.ops.nenhuma: nothing to apply — no pending change from the server.
cli.sync.ops.travaOcupada: {arquivo} is being synced by another process — retrying next time.
cli.tasks.migrate.nenhumSpec: no specs/<slug>/tasks.md found in this repo.
cli.tasks.migrate.jaCompleto: {slug}: every story already had a block.
cli.tasks.migrate.travaOcupada: {slug}: another sync is in progress — skipped, retrying next time.
cli.push.semSync: this repo does not push — run `arvys sync enable` first.
cli.push.recusado: REFUSED — secret found. Nothing went up:
cli.credencial.dentroDeGit: WARNING: {pasta} is inside a git repository ({repo}). The folder's own .gitignore is the defence; make sure nobody ran "git add -f".
cli.listaBranca.hardLink: allow-list: refusing "{caminho}" — it has {n} hard links (nlink={n}), it may point at content outside the repo. If it is a legitimate hard link, remake it as a normal file.
cli.credencial.aclIlegivel: (could not read the ACL to check)
cli.credencial.aclSobrando: the ACL still grants access to: {trustees}
cli.sync.recusadoPalavraVazia: nothing was written — the confirmation word ("{chave}") came back empty from the dictionary. The opt-in was NOT turned on. Run `npm run hub:sync` in the arvys-app repo to rebuild plugin/cli/dict/.
cli.segredos.aws_secret: AWS secret key (contextual — the file has AKIA…)
